errors.evidence: The chart displays data on 'Zufluss' (inflow), 'Abfluss' (outflow), and their difference. The term 'Flusstätern' (river perpetrators) is nonsensical and incorrect.
The y-axis unit is labeled 'Mrd. Euro' (Billions of Euros). The description incorrectly states the unit is 'Tausend Euro' (thousands of Euros).

errors.text_span: wobei der Wertebereich von -120.000 bis 28.000 Euro reicht
errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown on the chart is from -150.000 to 200.000, not -120.000 to 28.000.

errors.evidence: The green data series, representing 'Differenz Zufluss-Abfluss', is depicted as vertical bars, not a line.

errors.text_span: einem Minimum von -65.105 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2011
errors.evidence: The minimum value for the green bars is -112.219 in the year 2022, not -65.105 in 2011.

errors.text_span: das dann zu einem Maximum von 36.937 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2016 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The maximum value for the green bars is 27.499 in the year 2020. The value in 2016 is negative (approx. -53,643), and the value for 2017 is -36,937, which the machine seems to have misread and flipped the sign.

errors.text_span: schließlich mit 27.499 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2023 endet
errors.evidence: The value for the year 2023 is -67.319. The value 27.499 corresponds to the year 2020.

errors.text_span: Eine weitere Linie, die in Braun gezeichnet ist
errors.evidence: There is no brown line in the chart. The two lines are blue ('Abfluss') and purple ('Zufluss').
The description completely omits the blue line, which represents 'Abfluss' (Outflow).

errors.text_span: beginnend bei 48.646 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2005 und einem Minimum von -81.484 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2022, das dann zu einem Maximum von -64.546 Tausend Euro im Jahr 2011 ansteigt
errors.evidence: This entire phrase is factually incorrect. It describes a non-existent line using values (-48.646, -81.484, -64.546) taken from the green bars at different years and incorrectly assigns them as starting points, minimums, and maximums for a line series. The 'Zufluss' line is always positive.
